rationale: All four lenses and standards ran; all AC1-AC10 pass and no blocking finding survived. Reachability was checked for the store, hook, dialog and form candidates only; the rest are advisory. 5 advisory (included in the findings total), 0 deferred, 12 dismissed (see code-review-dismissed.local.md).

findings.title: Category change check is order-sensitive
findings.problem: changedMetadata compares values.categories.join() with the saved ids in order, so the same set in a different order counts as changed.
findings.impact: Only a reorder of the same categories triggers it, and the result is one needless categories PATCH that bumps the etag. No data is lost.
findings.recommendation: Compare sorted copies of both id lists.

findings.title: Create-mode project rule has no test
findings.problem: The yup context moved into useForm({ context: { creating, published } }). No test leaves the project empty on create and expects 'Project is required'. Same root cause as none.
findings.impact: Wiring reads correct today; only a future regression of the context would pass every test and let a project-less application be created.
findings.recommendation: Add a create-form test that clicks Create with no project, expects 'Project is required' and no api.post call.

findings.title: Category picker has no loading state
findings.problem: The picker is rendered with loadOnMount={false}, so while useHostedCategories is loading it shows no options and no spinner; saved ids may appear unnamed.
findings.impact: Brief cosmetic gap during the first load; a failure is surfaced by the separate notice with Retry.

findings.title: 412 re-read ignores latest categories
findings.problem: reread replaces revision and key but leaves selected untouched, so the next Publish sends the old selection over categories changed elsewhere.
findings.impact: Needs a concurrent edit of categories plus a 412 in the same dialog session; the user sees the error and presses Publish again knowingly.
findings.recommendation: Reseed selected from the re-read application when the user has not edited it, or tell the user the categories changed.

findings.title: Shared categories request never invalidated
findings.problem: The module-level request stays resolved after success; if assistantCategories is later emptied the hook reports ready with no categories and never refetches.
findings.impact: Needs the store list to be emptied after a successful load (store reset); then the picker stays empty until reload.
findings.recommendation: Clear request on success, or refetch when the store list is empty on mount.
